0a141cc93769b72a4107cfd63ce8323456082187.sourceText: 每500 ms真实时间尝试匹配一次，有点才处理；每轮降采样、估计局部形状、搜索地图对应点，最多做10次优化迭代。匹配报告收敛才更新结果，未收敛则沿用旧结果，但本轮累计点仍会清空。收敛表示算法停止条件满足，不证明匹配到了场地中正确的位置；源码没有再按匹配误差、有效对应比例等检查可信度。
0a141cc93769b72a4107cfd63ce8323456082187.translatedText: Every 500 ms of real time, one matching attempt is made, and processing is performed only if there are points; each round involves downsampling, estimating the local shape, and searching for corresponding points in the map, with at most 10 optimization iterations\. The matching report updates the result only upon convergence; if it does not converge, the old result is retained, but the points accumulated in this round are still cleared\.
